text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the first day of summer camp, and
the flames
of the grill are burning bright.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching them, I can't help but wonder
if there
isn't any way to fan smoldering
embers back into
a fierce blaze.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If you don't eat enough, the summer
heat will get
the best of you. Plus, how
will you grow up big
and strong?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Just look at me—this is my third grilled
carrot. ♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's so soft and scrumptious. I think I
have room
for a few more, actually.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A big appetite is normally a great
thing...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But it's hard to think so in this
situation. Summer
camp is a time to hone one's
body for upcoming races, but Wonder
Acute doesn't seem at all inclined in that
direction.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is something wrong? You've been staring
into the
fire for a while now...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Come on, dearie. Eat up now before it
burns.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take a nibble of the food she puts in
front of
me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And realize someone's overdone it on
the salt.
